nlq: Count of days in the last two weeks when the pool temperature was over 90.
golden_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::date) AS day_count FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = 'Pool' AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND r.value > 90 AND r.observed_at >= now() - interval '14 days'

nlq: What was the lowest outdoor temperature yesterday?
golden_sql: SELECT min(r.value) AS min_temp FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = 'Outdoor' AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::date - 1

nlq: What was the average outdoor humidity last week?
golden_sql: SELECT avg(r.value) AS avg_humidity FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = 'Outdoor' AND s.measurement_type = 'humidity' AND s.reliable = true AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone) >= date_trunc('week', (now() AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)) - interval '7 days' AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone) <  date_trunc('week', (now() AT TIME ZONE st.timezone))

nlq: Show me the hourly average pool temperature for the last 24 hours.
golden_sql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone) AS hour_local, avg(r.value) AS avg_temp FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = 'Pool' AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND r.observed_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.display_name, s.unit, lr.observed_at, lr.value FROM sensors s JOIN LATERAL (SELECT observed_at, value FROM sensor_readings r WHERE r.sensor_id = s.sensor_id ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) lr ON true WHERE s.physical_location = 'Pool' AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.is_active = true AND s.reliable = true

nlq: What was the peak wind gust in the last 30 days?
golden_sql: SELECT max(r.value) AS peak_gust, s.unit FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id WHERE s.measurement_type = 'wind_gust' AND s.reliable = true AND r.observed_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY s.unit

nlq: How much rain fell last month?
golden_sql: SELECT coalesce(sum(r.value), 0) AS total_rain FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id WHERE s.measurement_type = 'rain_total' AND s.reliable = true AND r.observed_at >= date_trunc('month', now() - interval '1 month') AND r.observed_at <  date_trunc('month', now())

nlq: Which day was the hottest this summer?
golden_sql: SELECT (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::date AS local_day, max(r.value) AS max_temp FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = 'Outdoor' AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone) >= '2026-06-01' AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone) <  '2026-09-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

nlq: When was the bedroom over 80 degrees?
golden_sql: SELECT min(r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone) AS first_time_over_80_local, max(r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone) AS last_time_over_80_local, count(*) AS reading_count FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = 'Bedroom' AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND r.value > 80
SELECT mac_address, name, latitude, longitude, timezone FROM stations ORDER BY name

nlq: What sensors do I have in the pool?
golden_sql: SELECT sensor_id, display_name, measurement_type, unit FROM sensors WHERE physical_location = 'Pool' AND is_active = true ORDER BY measurement_type

nlq: What's the temperature in the garage right now?
golden_sql: SELECT s.display_name, s.unit, lr.observed_at, lr.value FROM sensors s JOIN LATERAL (SELECT observed_at, value FROM sensor_readings r WHERE r.sensor_id = s.sensor_id ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) lr ON true WHERE s.physical_location = 'Garage' AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.is_active = true AND s.reliable = true

nlq: What time was the hottest temperature today?
golden_sql: SELECT (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::timestamp AS local_time, r.value, s.unit, s.display_name, s.physical_location FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::date ORDER BY r.value DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

nlq: What time was it hottest in the garage today?
golden_sql: SELECT (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::timestamp AS local_time, r.value, s.unit, s.display_name, s.physical_location FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = 'Garage' AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::date ORDER BY r.value DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

nlq: What time was it coldest outside yesterday?
golden_sql: SELECT (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::timestamp AS local_time, r.value, s.unit, s.display_name, s.physical_location FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensors s ON s.sensor_id = r.sensor_id JOIN stations st ON st.mac_address = s.station_id WHERE s.physical_location = 'Outdoor' AND s.measurement_type = 'temperature' AND s.reliable = true AND (r.observed_at AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE st.timezone)::date - 1 ORDER BY r.value ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
